summary: Customer C09582 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $236.28 (3660350) on card C09582-K1. Investigation revealed a definitive card-testing sequence on 2017-01-14, where four low-value online authorizations between $1.53 and $3.46 were executed within 27 minutes immediately prior to the larger purchase. This online activity on product C represents an abrupt shift from the holder's established historical baseline of over 700 in-person transactions on product W. The episode is confirmed as card_testing fraud with total exposure of $246.38, leading to card blocking and transaction declines.
open_question: The origin of the compromised card details cannot be pinpointed without merchant breach notification data. In addition, because device identifiers were unpopulated on the online authorization attempts, linking the unauthorized testing to a specific physical device hardware profile requires merchant-side server logs.

waiting.why: R5: card-testing sequence; decline pending authorizations
R5: a purchase over $100 has already cleared after the test sequence
